info.title: EkoWatch API
info.description:
Neighborhood Waste & Flood Alert System (Lagos) — Canonical REST API v1.

### Authentication
- **Public endpoints**: `POST /api/v1/auth/sessions` and `POST /api/v1/auth/login`
- **Protected endpoints**: All other `/api/v1/**` endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`

### Error Format (`application/problem+json`)
Every error response (`400`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `409`, `413`, `415`, `500`) returns `Content-Type: application/problem+json` with a stable `code` field (`VALIDATION_FAILED`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`, `UNAUTHENTICATED`, `FORBIDDEN`, `WARD_ASSIGNMENT_REQUIRED`, `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, `SELF_CONFIRMATION_NOT_ALLOWED`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`, `PHOTO_TOO_LARGE`, `UNSUPPORTED_PHOTO_TYPE`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`).

put.summary: Record waste collection completion idempotently (201 first time, 200 if already done)
put.description:
Requires Role: `OPERATOR` assigned to the street's ward and scheduled for `(streetId, collectionDate)`.
- **Returns `201 Created`** the first time the street is marked done for `collectionDate`.
- **Returns `200 OK`** when the street is already marked done for `collectionDate` (existing `CollectionView` is returned without overwriting `completedAt`).
- Returns `403 WARD_ASSIGNMENT_REQUIRED` if the operator is not assigned to the street's ward, or `403 FORBIDDEN` if not scheduled for that street/date.

200.description: Street was already marked done for this date (existing record returned without overwriting completedAt)

201.description: First time collection recorded for this street and date

post.summary: Create a resident waste or flood report idempotently (returns 201 Created)
post.description:
Requires Role: `RESIDENT` and a required `Idempotency-Key` UUID request header.
- **Always returns `201 Created`** (with `Location: /api/v1/reports/{reportId}`).
- **Idempotency**: If the client sends the **same `Idempotency-Key` and same request body** within 24 hours, the server returns the **exact same `ReportView` (`201 Created`)** without creating a duplicate report.
- If `Idempotency-Key` is missing, returns `400 Bad Request` (`code: "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED"`).
- If the same `Idempotency-Key` is reused with a different request body, returns `409 Conflict` (`code: "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED"`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required client-generated UUID. Sending the same key and same payload twice returns the same ReportView instead of creating a duplicate.

201.description: Report created (or original ReportView replayed on idempotent retry)

get.summary: List distinct streets scheduled for the authenticated operator in the date range
get.description:
Requires Role: `OPERATOR` (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`).
- **How `fromDate` and `toDate` filter**: Returns only the distinct streets in the operator's assigned ward(s) (`operator_wards`) that have a scheduled pickup assigned to this authenticated operator in `collection_schedules` between `fromDate` and `toDate` (inclusive, max 31-day window).
- If `fromDate` and `toDate` are omitted, defaults to today (in `Africa/Lagos`) through `today + 29 days`.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Start date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Defaults to today in Africa/Lagos if omitted.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: End date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, max 30 days after fromDate). Defaults to fromDate + 29 days if omitted.
